attributes.description: HPE server, switch, and storage health from SNMP — scenarios and queries

[{"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 48, "h": 14, "i": "p1"}, "panelIndex": "p1", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "HPE Device Overview", "markdown": "## HPE Infrastructure — Device Overview

Filter: `device.vendor: hpe` on data view `metrics-snmp.device-*` (or `metrics-*`).

**Devices in scope**

| Device | Role | Site | IP range |
|--------|------|------|----------|
| hpe-srv-01, hpe-srv-02 | server | prod | 10.10.5.x |
| hpe-srv-dr-01 | server | dr | 10.20.5.x |
| hpe-sw-prod-01, hpe-sw-prod-02 | switch | prod | 10.10.0.x |
| hpe-sw-dr-01 | switch | dr | 10.20.0.x |
| hpe-storage-prod-01 | storage | prod | 10.10.6.x |
| hpe-storage-dr-01 | storage | dr | 10.20.6.x |

**Discover query to see all HPE SNMP docs (last 24 h):**
```
GET /metrics-snmp.device-default/_search
{
  "size": 10,
  "query": {"bool": {"filter": [
    {"term": {"device.vendor": "hpe"}},
    {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-24h"}}}
  ]}}
}
```
", "openLinksInNewTab": true}, "hidePanelTitles": false, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 14, "w": 48, "h": 14, "i": "p2"}, "panelIndex": "p2", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "HPE Interface Traffic", "markdown": "## Interface Traffic Fields

Key counter fields (cumulative octets, reset at device reboot):

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable.ifEntry.ifInOctets.1` | eth1 bytes received |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable.ifEntry.ifOutOctets.1` | eth1 bytes sent |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable.ifEntry.ifOperStatus.1` | 1=up, 2=down |

Interfaces .2 through .8 follow the same pattern.

**Traffic spike query (HPE port_saturation scenario):**
```
POST /metrics-snmp.device-default/_search
{"size":5,"query":{"bool":{"filter":[{"term":{"device.vendor":"hpe"}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}}]}},"sort":[{"snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable.ifEntry.ifInOctets.1":"desc"}]}
```
", "openLinksInNewTab": true}, "hidePanelTitles": false, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 28, "w": 48, "h": 16, "i": "p3"}, "panelIndex": "p3", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "HPE Storage & Health", "markdown": "## Storage & System Health Fields

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.host.hrStorage.hrStorageTable.hrStorageEntry.hrStorageSize.1` | Total storage (512-byte blocks) |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.host.hrStorage.hrStorageTable.hrStorageEntry.hrStorageUsed.1` | Used storage |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.system.sysUpTime.sysUpTimeInstance` | Uptime (hundredths of a second) |
| `snmp.iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.system.sysDescr.0` | System description |
| `device.name` | Device hostname |

**RAID degraded scenario (hpe.raid_degraded):** storage size and used counters show unusual patterns.
**Fan failure scenario (hpe.fan_failure):** temperature metrics climb; look for anomalies in sysUpTime continuity.

**Count unique HPE devices reporting today:**
```
POST /metrics-snmp.device-default/_search
{"size":0,"query":{"bool":{"filter":[{"term":{"device.vendor":"hpe"}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1d"}}}]}},"aggs":{"devices":{"terms":{"field":"device.name","size":20}}}}
```
", "openLinksInNewTab": true}, "hidePanelTitles": false, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "markdown", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 44, "w": 48, "h": 10, "i": "p4"}, "panelIndex": "p4", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "HPE Scenario Schedule", "markdown": "## HPE Scenarios (every ~3 h ± 45 min)

| Scenario ID | Duration | What happens | Field to watch |
|-------------|----------|--------------|----------------|
| `hpe.fan_failure` | ~30 min | Fan status drops + temperature climb | `sysUpTime` anomaly + `ifOperStatus` |
| `hpe.port_saturation` | ~20 min | ifUtilization near 100% on eth1 | `ifInOctets.1` spikes |
| `hpe.raid_degraded` | ~45 min | Storage array health status change | `hrStorageSize.1` / `hrStorageUsed.1` pattern |

Scenario values are deterministic from `(t, GLOBAL_SEED)` — backfill and live data match exactly.
See `docs/scenarios/hpe.md` for full schedule documentation.
